name: Kougami Shiho
source:
Kamori's workplace buddy at the AW-SON convenience store. She usually takes the day-shift with Kamori taking evenings and nights so they see each other often because of the overlap. 

[Spoiler] Although Kamori develops a Baroque link with Shiho towards the end of Sachi's arc, she does not manifest any powers before the Gestalt withdraws. At the end of the arc, she provides Kamori with a place to stay after the latter resolves to never see Nao and Yachiru again to help her forget the trauma she suffered during the Disaster. [/Spoiler]
